description: Renders CSV files in a clean, paginated table with column sorting, row highlighting, frozen headers, column width adjustment, and search/filter functionality. Supports large files with virtual scrolling.
h1: CSV Viewer — Instant Table Rendering for Any CSV File
p: Stop squinting at raw comma-separated text. Drop your CSV and watch it transform into a crisp, sortable table in milliseconds — no spreadsheet software, no signups, no nonsense.

description: In-browser editable spreadsheet interface for CSV files. Supports cell editing, row/column add/delete, undo/redo, inline validation, and export back to CSV.
h1: CSV Editor — Edit CSV Files Directly in Your Browser
p: A lightweight, no-install CSV editor that feels like a spreadsheet. Click any cell, make your changes, and download a clean file — your data stays on your machine the entire time.

description: Validates CSV structure including consistent column counts, header presence, data type consistency per column, encoding issues, empty rows, and custom rule definitions.
h1: CSV Validator — Catch Structural Errors Before They Break Your Pipeline
p: Malformed CSVs silently corrupt imports and crash scripts. Run your file through our validator to expose mismatched columns, rogue delimiters, and encoding gremlins before they cause real damage.

description: Standardizes CSV formatting: normalizes quoting, fixes inconsistent delimiters, trims whitespace, enforces consistent line endings (CRLF/LF), and re-encodes to UTF-8.
h1: CSV Formatter — Standardize Messy CSVs to a Clean, Consistent Format
p: Every data source has its own quirks — inconsistent quotes, mixed delimiters, rogue whitespace. Our CSV Formatter irons them all out and hands you back a file that plays nicely with every tool in your stack.

description: Outputs a human-readable, padded plain-text table from a CSV file. Columns are aligned using fixed-width padding, making the data easy to read in terminals, docs, or emails.
h1: CSV Pretty Print — Turn Raw CSV Into Readable Aligned Text Tables
p: Raw CSV is for machines. Pretty-printed CSV is for humans. Instantly convert your file into a neatly padded, column-aligned text table perfect for documentation, Slack messages, or terminal output.

description: Strips unnecessary whitespace, blank lines, redundant quotes, and optional BOM markers from CSV files to reduce file size while preserving data integrity.
h1: CSV Minifier — Shrink CSV File Size Without Losing a Single Data Point
p: Bloated CSVs slow down uploads, APIs, and imports. Our minifier strips every unnecessary byte — trailing spaces, redundant quotes, blank lines — giving you the leanest possible file with all your data intact.

description: Converts CSV to JSON array of objects using headers as keys. Options include nested JSON output, array-of-arrays mode, type inference, and pretty vs minified output.
h1: CSV to JSON Converter — Transform Spreadsheet Data Into API-Ready JSON
p: Bridge the gap between flat files and modern APIs. Convert any CSV into clean JSON objects in one click — with smart type inference, optional nesting, and output that's ready to plug straight into your codebase.

description: Flattens JSON arrays of objects into CSV rows. Handles nested objects via dot-notation flattening, array expansion, custom header ordering, and missing key handling.
h1: JSON to CSV Converter — Flatten JSON Arrays Into Clean Spreadsheet-Ready CSV
p: Got an API response or data export trapped in JSON? Flatten it into a clean, column-structured CSV in seconds — with smart handling for nested objects and missing fields that would otherwise break your sheet.

description: Converts CSV files to .xlsx format with proper column formatting, auto-fit column widths, header row styling, and multi-sheet support for multiple CSVs.
h1: CSV to Excel Converter — Export CSV Files to Formatted .XLSX Spreadsheets
p: Not everyone speaks CSV. Convert your data to a properly formatted Excel workbook — with styled headers, auto-sized columns, and .xlsx compatibility that opens perfectly in every version of Excel.

description: Extracts sheets from .xlsx/.xls files and converts them to CSV. Supports sheet selection, merged cell handling, date formatting, and number format normalization.
h1: Excel to CSV Converter — Extract Any Excel Sheet Into a Clean CSV File
p: Free your data from Excel's proprietary grip. Choose any sheet from an .xlsx file and convert it to a portable, universally compatible CSV — with sensible handling for merged cells and date formats.

description: Converts comma-delimited CSV to tab-separated values (TSV). Handles quoted commas in fields safely, preserves all data, and outputs clean .tsv files.
h1: CSV to TSV Converter — Switch Delimiters From Commas to Tabs Safely
p: Some tools demand tabs, not commas. Our converter safely swaps delimiters while correctly handling fields that contain commas — no manual find-and-replace nightmares, no corrupted columns.

description: Converts tab-separated value files to standard CSV. Handles embedded tabs in quoted fields, normalizes line endings, and outputs RFC 4180-compliant CSV.
h1: TSV to CSV Converter — Convert Tab-Separated Files to Standard CSV Format
p: TSV from a database dump or legacy export? Convert it to universally supported CSV in a single step — with proper quoting applied wherever your data contains commas or special characters.

description: Transforms CSV rows into XML elements with configurable root element names, row element tags, header-as-attribute or header-as-child-element options, and pretty-printed output.
h1: CSV to XML Converter — Transform Tabular CSV Data Into Structured XML
p: Convert flat CSV data into well-formed XML with full control over element names, attribute vs child node structure, and indentation. Generate XML that's ready for legacy systems, APIs, or data interchange pipelines.

description: Parses XML and extracts repeating element structures into CSV rows. Supports XPath-based node targeting, attribute extraction, and namespace handling.
h1: XML to CSV Converter — Extract Structured XML Data Into Flat CSV Tables
p: XML is powerful but painful to analyze. Point our converter at any repeating XML structure and extract it into a clean, flat CSV — perfect for reporting, analysis, or feeding into downstream tools.

description: Converts CSV rows to YAML list of mappings. Supports type inference (strings, numbers, booleans, nulls), custom indentation, and anchor/alias generation for repeated values.
h1: CSV to YAML Converter — Turn CSV Data Into Human-Readable YAML Configuration
p: From data tables to config files in one step. Convert CSV into clean YAML mappings with automatic type detection — ideal for seeding configuration files, test fixtures, or deployment manifests.

description: Generates SQL INSERT statements or CREATE TABLE + INSERT scripts from CSV data. Supports MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite dialects, type inference, and batch insert sizing.
h1: CSV to SQL Converter — Generate INSERT Statements From CSV Data Instantly
p: Skip the manual SQL writing. Upload your CSV and get a ready-to-run SQL script — complete with a CREATE TABLE statement and properly typed INSERT rows — in the dialect your database actually speaks.

description: Parses SQL INSERT statements and extracts row values into CSV format. Handles multi-row inserts, escaped strings, NULL values, and quoted identifiers.
h1: SQL to CSV Converter — Extract Row Data From SQL INSERT Scripts Into CSV
p: Got a SQL dump full of INSERT statements and need the raw data? Paste your SQL and extract every row into a clean, portable CSV — without spinning up a database or writing a single query.

description: Converts CSV to a styled HTML table with options for CSS class names, inline styles, striped rows, bordered layout, sortable headers via JS, and responsive wrapper.
h1: CSV to HTML Table — Convert CSV Data Into Embeddable HTML Tables
p: Publish your data on the web without touching a spreadsheet plugin. Convert any CSV into a clean HTML table — styled, responsive, and ready to paste directly into your website or CMS.

description: Scrapes HTML table elements from pasted HTML or a URL and exports the data as CSV. Handles colspan/rowspan merging, multiple tables on a page, and header detection.
h1: HTML Table to CSV — Scrape Any HTML Table Into a Downloadable CSV File
p: See a data table on a webpage but can't easily copy it? Paste the HTML and pull out every row and column into a clean CSV — with smart handling for merged cells and multi-table pages.

description: Converts CSV to GitHub-Flavored Markdown table syntax. Supports column alignment (left, right, center), padding options, and handles special Markdown characters via escaping.
h1: CSV to Markdown Table — Paste CSV, Get a GitHub-Ready Markdown Table
p: Stop manually formatting Markdown tables character by character. Paste your CSV and get perfectly aligned Markdown table syntax — ready to drop into a README, wiki, or pull request description.

description: Converts CSV into programming language array literals: JavaScript, Python, PHP, Ruby, and more. Options for array-of-objects, array-of-arrays, or flat single-column arrays.
h1: CSV to Array Converter — Convert CSV Into Code-Ready Arrays in Any Language
p: Stop copy-pasting data into code by hand. Convert any CSV column or full table into a native array literal for JavaScript, Python, PHP, or Ruby — correctly formatted and ready to paste into your project.

description: Converts CSV rows to formatted plain text using customizable templates per row. Useful for generating mailing list copy, templated messages, or human-readable summaries from structured data.
h1: CSV to Text Converter — Generate Plain Text Content From CSV Rows Using Templates
p: Transform rows of data into natural-language text using your own template. Merge field values into sentences, bullets, or custom formats — ideal for generating personalized messages, reports, or content at scale.

description: Parses unstructured or semi-structured text (whitespace-delimited, fixed-width, or pattern-based) and converts it to structured CSV. Includes column detection and preview.
h1: Text to CSV Converter — Parse Unstructured Text and Export It as Structured CSV
p: Have data stuck in a text file, log, or copy-pasted table? Our parser detects columns from whitespace, patterns, or fixed widths and converts the whole thing into a properly structured CSV — ready for analysis.

description: Lets users select one or more columns by name or index and exports only those columns as a new CSV. Supports reordering output columns and renaming headers on extraction.
h1: CSV Column Extractor — Pull Specific Columns From Large CSV Files Instantly
p: When you only need three columns from a fifty-column export, don't wrestle with Excel. Select exactly the columns you want, rename them if needed, and download a clean, trimmed CSV in seconds.

description: Removes selected columns from a CSV file by name or index. Supports multi-column removal, preview before download, and safe handling of quoted fields across all rows.
h1: CSV Column Remover — Strip Unwanted Columns From CSV Files in One Click
p: Sharing data externally but need to drop sensitive or irrelevant columns first? Select the columns to remove, preview the result, and download a clean file — without opening Excel or writing a script.

description: Drag-and-drop interface to reorder CSV columns. Supports manual index input for large files, header renaming, and outputs a new CSV with columns in the specified order.
h1: CSV Column Reorder Tool — Drag and Drop CSV Columns Into Any Order
p: Rearrange CSV columns visually instead of scripting it. Drag headers into the order you need, rename them on the fly, and download a restructured file that matches your target schema exactly.

description: Splits a single CSV column into multiple columns using a configurable delimiter, regex, or fixed-width pattern. Handles cases like full name → first/last or address → parts.
h1: CSV Column Splitter — Split One CSV Column Into Multiple Columns by Any Pattern
p: Full names jammed into one column? Addresses that should be five fields? Split any column into as many parts as you need using delimiters, regex, or fixed positions — no formulas, no fuss.

description: Combines two or more CSV columns into a single new column using a configurable separator or template string. Original columns can be kept or removed.
h1: CSV Column Merger — Combine Multiple CSV Columns Into a Single Field
p: Concatenate first name + last name, city + state + zip, or any set of columns into one using any separator you choose. Merge columns with a custom template and optionally remove the originals — instantly.

description: Filters CSV rows using conditions on one or more columns (equals, contains, regex, numeric comparisons, date ranges). Supports AND/OR logic and outputs matched or unmatched rows.
h1: CSV Row Filter — Filter CSV Rows by Column Values Without Writing Code
p: Extract exactly the rows you care about using intuitive conditions — filter by value, range, pattern, or date across any column. Combine rules with AND/OR logic and download the matching subset in seconds.

description: Sorts CSV rows by one or more columns in ascending or descending order. Supports numeric, alphabetical, and date-aware sorting with multi-column sort priority.
h1: CSV Row Sorter — Sort CSV Data by Any Column, Number, Date, or Alphabet
p: Sort your CSV by any column — or chain multiple sort rules together. Numeric, alphabetic, and date-aware sorting all handled correctly, so your rows come out in exactly the order you need.

description: Counts total rows, non-empty rows, blank rows, and optionally rows matching a filter condition. Displays per-column fill rate and null value statistics.
h1: CSV Row Counter — Count Rows, Blanks, and Completeness Stats for Any CSV
p: How many rows are actually in that file? How many are blank? What's the fill rate per column? Get a fast, complete row count and data completeness report without opening the file in Excel.

description: Displays all CSV column headers for easy inline editing. Supports bulk rename via find-and-replace, case normalization, whitespace trimming, and snake_case/camelCase conversion.
h1: CSV Header Editor — Rename, Recase, and Clean CSV Column Headers in Bulk
p: Headers like 'First Name ', 'LAST_NAME', and 'e mail' breaking your imports? Rename, normalize case, trim spaces, and convert to snake_case or camelCase across all headers at once.

description: Identifies and removes duplicate rows from CSV files. Supports full-row deduplication or key-column based deduplication, with options to keep first/last occurrence.
h1: CSV Duplicate Remover — Find and Delete Duplicate Rows From CSV Files
p: Duplicate rows contaminate analysis, bloat databases, and silently inflate metrics. Remove them in one step — deduplicate on all columns or just a key field, keeping the first or last occurrence as you choose.

description: Advanced deduplication with fuzzy matching support for near-duplicate detection. Configurable similarity threshold, phonetic matching, and grouped duplicate report output.
h1: CSV Deduplicator — Remove Exact and Fuzzy Duplicate Records From CSV Data
p: Exact duplicates are easy. But what about 'Jon Smith' vs 'John Smith'? Our deduplicator catches near-duplicates using fuzzy matching and phonetic algorithms — so your data is clean even when humans weren't consistent.

description: Performs SQL-style joins (inner, left, right, full outer) on two CSV files using a shared key column. Outputs merged rows with configurable column prefix handling for conflicts.
h1: CSV Join / Merge Tool — SQL-Style Joins for CSV Files Without a Database
p: Join two CSV files on a shared key column — just like a SQL JOIN, but without a database. Inner, left, right, or full outer join — pick your type, map your key columns, and get a merged file instantly.

description: Splits a single large CSV into multiple smaller files by row count, file size, or column value groups. Preserves headers in every output file and supports ZIP download.
h1: CSV Splitter — Break Large CSV Files Into Smaller Chunks by Rows or Groups
p: A 500,000-row CSV doesn't fit in most tools. Split it into equally sized chunks, or divide it by the values in a key column — each output file gets its own header and can be downloaded as a ZIP.

description: Combines multiple CSV files into a single unified CSV. Handles mismatched columns with configurable alignment strategies, optional source filename column, and deduplication on merge.
h1: CSV File Merger — Combine Multiple CSV Files Into One Unified Dataset
p: Monthly exports, regional data splits, batch outputs — merge them all into one clean CSV. Handles mismatched column sets intelligently and optionally tags each row with its source file.

description: Changes the delimiter of a CSV file between comma, semicolon, pipe, tab, or custom character. Safely re-quotes fields that contain the new delimiter.
h1: CSV Delimiter Converter — Change CSV Delimiter to Comma, Semicolon, Pipe, or Tab
p: European exports use semicolons. Your tool expects pipes. Our converter switches delimiters in seconds — and automatically adds proper quoting around any fields that contain the new separator character.

description: Applies or normalizes quoting to all CSV fields — wrapping fields containing delimiters, newlines, or special characters. Supports single, double, and custom quote characters.
h1: CSV Quote Escaper — Properly Quote and Escape All Fields in a CSV File
p: Unquoted fields with embedded commas or newlines corrupt CSV parsers. Our tool applies proper RFC 4180 quoting across every field that needs it — so your file parses correctly everywhere it's used.

description: Strips unnecessary quote characters from CSV fields that don't require quoting. Reduces file size and improves readability while preserving quoting where it is semantically required.
h1: CSV Unquote Tool — Remove Unnecessary Quotes From Over-Quoted CSV Files
p: Some exporters wrap every single field in quotes — even plain integers and booleans that don't need it. Strip the clutter, reduce file size, and get a clean CSV where quotes only appear when they matter.

description: Automated CSV cleaning: trims whitespace, removes blank rows, fixes encoding issues, normalizes line endings, strips BOM, and reports all changes made with a clean/dirty diff.
h1: CSV Cleaner — Automatically Fix Common CSV Issues in One Pass
p: Trailing spaces, blank rows, BOM markers, Windows line endings — the tedious stuff that breaks imports and wastes your time. Run it through our cleaner and get a corrected file with a full report of what changed.

description: Normalizes data values across CSV columns: standardizes date formats, phone numbers, currencies, casing, country codes, and boolean representations using configurable rules per column.
h1: CSV Data Normalizer — Standardize Dates, Phone Numbers, and Values Across CSV Columns
p: Mixed date formats, inconsistent phone number styles, 'Yes/yes/YES/1/true' in the same column — our normalizer applies consistent formatting rules across your data so every value speaks the same language.

description: Transposes a CSV file — swapping rows and columns. Useful for pivoting narrow/long data to wide format. Handles headers correctly and outputs a properly structured transposed CSV.
h1: CSV Transpose Tool — Swap Rows and Columns in Any CSV File Instantly
p: When your data is oriented the wrong way, transposing manually in Excel is a nightmare for large files. Flip rows to columns and columns to rows in one click — headers handled correctly, every time.

description: Generates synthetic CSV data with configurable column types (name, email, date, UUID, number range, boolean, custom list). Outputs any number of random rows for testing and prototyping.
h1: CSV Random Row Generator — Generate Realistic Fake CSV Data for Testing
p: Stop hand-crafting test data. Define your columns and data types, choose how many rows you need, and generate a realistic fake CSV dataset in seconds — perfect for development, QA, and load testing.

description: Extracts a random or stratified sample of N rows from a large CSV file. Supports percentage-based and fixed-count sampling with optional seed for reproducibility.
h1: CSV Sample Generator — Extract a Random Sample From Any Large CSV File
p: Working with millions of rows but only need a representative slice? Extract a random sample of any size — by row count or percentage — with optional stratification to ensure balanced representation across key columns.

description: Computes per-column statistics: count, null rate, unique values, min/max, mean/median/mode, standard deviation, and value frequency distribution. Outputs a summary report.
h1: CSV Column Statistics — Get Instant Descriptive Stats for Every Column in Your CSV
p: Understand your data before you process it. Get count, nulls, min, max, mean, median, and top values for every column in your CSV — all in one summary report, with no code required.

description: Scans all columns in a CSV for valid email addresses and extracts them into a deduplicated list. Supports domain filtering, validation, and output as plain list or new CSV.
h1: CSV Email Extractor — Pull All Valid Email Addresses Out of Any CSV File
p: Email addresses scattered across multiple columns, mixed in with other data? Our extractor scans every cell, validates each address, deduplicates the results, and hands you a clean list — ready for your email tool.

description: Full-text and column-specific search across CSV file contents. Supports exact match, substring, regex, and case-insensitive search with highlighted results and row-level export of matches.
h1: CSV Search Tool — Search Across Every Row and Column in a CSV File
p: Find exactly what you're looking for inside a CSV without opening it in Excel. Search by value, pattern, or regex across all columns or a specific one — and export just the matching rows as a new CSV.
